Keep the blue lace-trimmed bikini and small seahorse necklace shown. Show a subtle coastal road and ocean view through the side window, using bright 5600K soft daylight entering through the windows to create gentle directional shadows and subtly highlight her shoulders and chest area through the bikini. Frame the image as a polished but candid travel portrait with detailed red leather, clear natural skin texture, deep red and cadet-blue color contrast, and a confident summer mood. No text, logo, or watermark.
